title: Try Again
subject: English
summary: “Try Again” is a poem about King Bruce of Scotland, who becomes very sad after failing many times to achieve something great for his people. He feels hopeless and decides to give up. Suddenly, he sees a small spider trying to climb up to its web. The spider falls down many times but does not stop trying. After nine failed attempts, it finally succeeds in reaching its web. Watching the spider inspires King Bruce. He decides to try once again and finally achieves success. The poem teaches us that we should never give up after failure because patience, courage and continuous efforts lead to success.
